name: Rob Savage
bio: Robert Savage (born July 22, 1992) is an English filmmaker. He is best known for directing the horror films Host (2020), Dashcam (2021), The Boogeyman (2023) and Other Mommy (2026).

credits.title: Other Mommy
credits.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

credits.title: The Boogeyman
credits.overview: Still reeling from the tragic death of their mother, a teenage girl and her younger sister find themselves plagued by a sadistic presence in their house and struggle to get their grieving father to pay attention before it’s too late.

credits.title: The Legacy of The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
credits.overview: Philipp Escott returns to the roots of THE TEXAS CHAIN SAW MASSACRE, accompanied by familiar filmmakers and critics, delving into the reasons behind the movie’s impact on an entire generation and its perpetuating legacy.

credits.title: Do You Believe In Ghosts?: 30 Years of Ghostwatch
credits.overview: A 30th anniversary documentary about Ghostwatch.

credits.title: Dashcam
credits.overview: At the start of the pandemic, an indulgent and self-deluded livestreaming improv musician abandons L.A. for London, steals her ex-bandmate's car, and makes the fateful decision to give a ride to an elderly woman who is not what she seems.

credits.title: The Found Footage Phenomenon
credits.overview: The documentary tracks the origins of the found footage technique and how it transformed with technological changes throughout the last few decades.

credits.title: Covidwood
credits.overview: A French documentary on how Covid-19 affected Hollywood and the cinema industry in the United States.

credits.title: Host
credits.overview: Six friends hire a medium to hold a séance via Zoom during lockdown — but they get far more than they bargained for as things quickly go wrong. When an evil spirit starts invading their homes, they begin to realise they might not survive the night.

credits.title: I’ve Been Hearing Strange Noises from My Attic…
credits.overview: London-based horror film director Rob Savage hears strange noises coming from the attic of his house, so he video-calls a few friends and goes to investigate…

credits.title: Salt
credits.overview: Each night, a mother must defend her sickly daughter from a demonic force. Her only weapon: a circle of salt.

credits.title: Girls on Film 2: Before Dawn
credits.overview: An electric collection of the latest, award-winning lesbian and feminist short films exploring fantasies, dreams, desires, love and transgression. Featuring chance encounters, teenage lust, girl fighters, self-conscious dolls and rampant zombies alongside journeys of self-discovery, the fight for equality and a playful

credits.title: Dawn of the Deaf
credits.overview: On the eve of a catastrophic event which will wipe out the hearing population, we follow four deaf characters as they go about their daily lives.

credits.title: Absence
credits.overview: Absence offers a snapshot of a man mourning someone very close to him, and over the course of the film we get some clues as to the sinister cause of his grief.

credits.title: Healey's House
credits.overview: A young couple travel from England to Scotland to address a haunting memory from their past.

credits.title: Valentine
credits.overview: On Valentine's Day, a hopless romantic and a cynic realise love is right in front of them.

credits.title: Strings
credits.overview: A German exchange student begins an impulsive and ultimately destructive relationship with a shy British boy in her final weeks before returning to Munich and her warring family.

credits.title: Sticks and Stones
credits.overview: A children's game of soldiers takes a sinister turn as a bullied outcast from school becomes involved.

credits.title: Touching from a Distance
credits.overview: A romantic moment shared between lovers...

credits.title: Polaroid
credits.overview: An intimate moment between a young couple sets in motion a series of memories, delving into buried aspects of their relationship.

credits.title: Sit in Silence
credits.overview: A man waits for his shift to end in a train station ticket booth while the world ends around him.

credits.title: Act
credits.overview: An intimate conversation between a teenage couple is played out directly to camera. As we look into their eyes and faces we begin to see hidden motives at play, far removed from the naively idealised surface... Is it all just an act?

credits.title: Sex Scene
credits.overview: A short film exploring sex and what we get out of it: security, validation, ownership? Do we all perceive sex differently?
